title: Austria Leo:
title_short: Austria Leo · More Than a Hobby
headline: A young Leo from Austria moved away to study, kept his club family through a twinning, and goes on holidays with them.
story: Atdhe asks if anyone in his club feels like family. Yes: the people he served with on the board. They go on holidays together and keep up with each other's lives. It is more than just a hobby, it's a family. He moved away to study, and because the clubs had a twinning, switching was easy. His family came with him.
The last quarter ties it back: people working towards the same goals and sharing the same values make him very happy. Young, calm, sincere. Let him be dry and honest.

client_note: Why this matters: Hong Kong cuts lead with friendship. His club family is specific: board friends who go on holidays together, and a twinning that let him keep them when he moved to study. Ledger tag: YOUTH-LEO, sub-angle “moved away to study, the twinning kept his club family” (Zimbabwe is “each person plays a different role in my life”). transcript:
Transcript of IMG_8027.MOV (Austria Leo, Hong Kong Convention). Times are mm:ss in the source file. Atdhe asks the questions behind the phone. Speaker labels are automatic and wrong, so they are left out.
IMG_8027.MOV
[00:00] So, the first question is, are you happy?
[00:03] I'm very happy. It's always very nice to be at the conventions and see so many other people here.
[00:12] What is the source of your happiness?
[00:14] I think that people who are working towards the same goals, who are sharing the same values,
[00:24] talking about ideas how to achieve those goals, make me very happy.
[00:35] No worries, no worries, very good.
[00:37] So, tell me about the moment you decided to join Lions Club, or the Leo Club.
[00:44] I think I was still very young, but I've seen what the Lions can do and how the community works
[00:51] and what they can do for the community as well.
[00:54] And I thought, yeah, this is something which I'm really interested in,
[00:57] and this is something where you can learn a lot of stuff and take responsibility.
[01:01] And then it was very clear for me that this would be the right organization for me.
[01:06] How long have you been involved with Lions?
[01:08] I joined in 2019, so almost seven years now.
[01:13] I switched clubs also because I moved away for studies,
[01:17] but since the clubs had a twinning, it was really easy for me to switch,
[01:21] and I think even more that international collaboration is something which goes really deep in our organization.
[01:29] Is there anybody in your club that feels like family to you?
[01:34] Yes, of course.
[01:36] I mean, especially with the people I've served for a long time on the board,
[01:41] and we are doing holidays together, and we are recording each other, what's going on in their lives.
[01:48] It's really, I don't know, more than just a hobby, it's a family.
[01:55] If you could give one message to the entire world, what would that message be?
[02:05] Think about your life, but also your community and the whole world,
[02:10] and think about how you can make an impact to change it and make it maybe a little bit better,
[02:15] and I think then you would be a really big step closer to you.
